from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Alignment, Font, PatternFill
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

output_file = "invoice_12345.xlsx"

invoice_fields = [
    ("Invoice Number", "12345"),
    ("Date", "2024-06-01"),
    ("Customer", "Alice Example"),
    ("Address", "123 Main Street, Cityville"),
]

line_items = [
    {
        "Item Description": "Widget A",
        "Quantity": 10,
        "Unit Price": 5.00,
        "Total": 50.00,
    }
]

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Invoice"

# Title
ws.merge_cells("A1:D1")
ws["A1"] = "Invoice"
ws["A1"].font = Font(size=18, bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
ws["A1"].fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="1F4E78")
ws["A1"].alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

# Invoice details
for row_number, (label, value) in enumerate(invoice_fields, start=3):
    ws.cell(row=row_number, column=1, value=label)
    ws.cell(row=row_number, column=2, value=value)
    ws.cell(row=row_number, column=1).font = Font(bold=True)

# Line-item table
table_row = 8
headers = ["Item Description", "Quantity", "Unit Price", "Total"]

for column_number, header in enumerate(headers, start=1):
    cell = ws.cell(row=table_row, column=column_number, value=header)
    cell.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    cell.fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="5B9BD5")
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

for row_number, item in enumerate(line_items, start=table_row + 1):
    for column_number, header in enumerate(headers, start=1):
        ws.cell(
            row=row_number,
            column=column_number,
            value=item[header],
        )

    ws.cell(row=row_number, column=3).number_format = "$0.00"
    ws.cell(row=row_number, column=4).number_format = "$0.00"

# Footer
footer_row = table_row + len(line_items) + 2
ws.merge_cells(
    start_row=footer_row,
    start_column=1,
    end_row=footer_row,
    end_column=4,
)
ws.cell(row=footer_row, column=1, value="Thank you for your business!")
ws.cell(row=footer_row, column=1).font = Font(italic=True)
ws.cell(row=footer_row, column=1).alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

# Layout
column_widths = {
    "A": 24,
    "B": 30,
    "C": 15,
    "D": 15,
}

for column, width in column_widths.items():
    ws.column_dimensions[column].width = width

ws.freeze_panes = "A9"
ws.auto_filter.ref = f"A{table_row}:D{table_row + len(line_items)}"
ws.sheet_view.showGridLines = False

wb.save(output_file)
print(f"Created {output_file}")
